name: convex
description: Query and transact on the Convex lattice network (CVM) — balances, contracts, on-chain state. Load for anything blockchain-side.

content.inline:
## Convex
- query `{source, address?, peer?}` — read-only CVM execution, free, no signature. Example: `(balance #128)`.
- transact `{source, address, seed?, peer?}` — a signed transaction that changes state; costs juice. Credentials via secret refs, never inline.

Writing CVM (Convex Lisp) source:
- NEVER use `import` in generated source — it mutates the account environment and wastes juice.
- Single call: `(@convex.fungible/transfer #128 #13 100)` — `@name.path` resolves via CNS at runtime.
- Multiple calls: `(let [fun @convex.fungible] (fun/transfer ...) (fun/balance ...))`.
- Addresses are `#123` literals. The native coin is CVM: 1 CVM = 10^9 copper (all on-chain amounts are copper).

Prefer query for anything read-only — transactions are irreversible and metered. Echo the exact source you executed when reporting results.
